title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 231
paragraphs: If then we judge these matters rightly, the opinion of the Ionians about Egypt is not sound. But if the judgment of the Ionians is right, then I declare that neither the Hellenes nor the Ionians themselves know how to reckon, since they say the whole earth is made up of three divisions — Europe, Asia, and Libya: for they ought to add to these the Delta of Egypt, since it belongs neither to Asia nor to Libya. For according to their reckoning it cannot be the river Nile that divides Asia from Libya, since the Nile is cleft at the point of this Delta so as to flow round it, with the result that this land would come between Asia and Libya.
